In September 2024, Member States will have to submit to the Commission the list of installations covered by the Directive, as well as any free allocation for the period 2026 to 2030 for each installation in the list, calculated in accordance with Union-wide harmonised free allocation rules.

The data collected, referred to as National Implementation Measures (NIMs), must be verified and assessed by the Member States and thereafter submitted to the Commission in September 2024 that will, in turn, perform an assessment to determine compliance with the relevant legal provisions.

Moreover, it will be crucial to ensure comparably robust data across Member States, so a thorough assessment will need to be performed.
